cases.selection: Score-only deterministic selection after all cells: largest rank spread and lowest best-model nDCG@10 contribution, with query-ID hash tie breaks.
cases.tracked_content: Opaque case IDs, aggregate mechanism summary, and restricted local evidence hashes only.

execution.measured_trials: One full exact top-100 search per canonical query; record per-query latency.
execution.resume: Finalized representation and cell manifests must validate by external SHA256 before reuse; partial cells are rejected by default.
execution.warmup: One synthetic query against up to 256 synthetic/bounded windows before measured track search.

query and document routes produce the frozen dimension
scoring masks are boolean, nonempty, and exclude zero adapter padding
all vectors and scores are finite
project exact MaxSim equals independent NumPy MaxSim within 1e-5
the predeclared positive is uniquely rank one
gate.source: Project-authored synthetic English facts with no benchmark source text or identifiers.

call_stack: project exact MaxSim and max_passage aggregation
models.lineage: PyLate checkpoint based on Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base and distilled on MS MARCO.
models.mask_policy: document punctuation is removed from the scoring mask; ordinary attention padding is excluded
models.padding_policy: ragged scoring-mask compaction; any adapter padding is zero with an explicit boolean mask
models.query_expansion: disabled; queries retain only the saved scoring-mask positions up to 48 tokens
models.query_route: encode_query with saved query route and no mask-token expansion
models.remote_code_risk: No Python files or auto_map; standard ModernBERT plus saved Sentence Transformers modules.

protocol.aggregation_definition: Score every window by exact MaxSim and retain the maximum score per canonical passage; ties choose the lower window ordinal.
protocol.candidate_policy: Full independent 7,500-passage track after query-specific excluded IDs; no learned candidate generator.
protocol.mask: Use the model's final scoring attention mask after query expansion and document punctuation filtering; compact valid rows for storage and retain an explicit boolean-valid mask.
protocol.normalization: Use checkpoint-native per-token normalization loaded by MultiVectorEncoder; no post-hoc score normalization.
protocol.padding: Padded rows in adapter validation are zero and mask=false; compact formal storage contains only mask=true rows plus offsets.
protocol.representation_storage: Concatenated float32 token vectors, int64 offsets, boolean valid-token mask, and restricted window-to-passage mapping.
protocol.retrieval_unit: Canonical BRIGHT pilot passage; no cross-track pooling.
protocol.score: For each valid query token, take the maximum float32 dot product over valid document-window tokens, then sum in query-token order.
protocol.tie_policy: Sort by descending float32 score, then canonical passage ID; public artifacts never expose that ID.

windowing.long_passage: Use overlapping source substrings; force a final tail-aligned window and remove duplicate spans.
windowing.short_passage: Preserve the exact canonical string when it has at most 128 word tokens.

limitations: training overlap unknown; not verified zero-shot
no production SLA or complete cross-paradigm ranking claim

slices.definition: Lowercase strip canonical query text and count Unicode word tokens with (?u)\b\w+\b.
For each positive passage, divide unique lowercase Unicode query/document token intersection by unique query tokens and use the maximum across positives.
Count Unicode word tokens for every positive passage and bin a query by the median positive-passage count.
Count unique canonical positive qrel passage IDs per query after materialization validation.

stopping_conditions: Any selected snapshot becomes gated/private, changes license, requires remote code, or exceeds its download cap.
Any gate fails, any representation is non-finite/empty/wrong-dimensional, or exact scorers disagree.
Observed VRAM exceeds 11 GiB after exhausting the frozen batch fallback.
A cell exceeds one hour or a model exceeds two hours; do not silently change semantic lengths, windows, aggregation, candidates, metrics, or dtype.
Any tracked artifact contains benchmark source text, canonical IDs, raw rankings, reversible mappings, secrets, or private filesystem paths.

uncertainty.comparisons: All three model pairs within each track; never pool tracks.
uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap over matched queries
uncertainty.small_slice_policy: n=0 is NA; n=1-9 has point estimates only; n>=10 has paired intervals; bins are never merged.
